WITH round_totals AS ( SELECT work_order_id,COUNT(*) AS round_count,COUNT(submitted_at) AS submitted_count, SUM(CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL OR (submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_at<started_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_round_count, SUM(CASE WHEN submitted_at>=started_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,started_at,submitted_at)/1000 ELSE 0 END) AS repair_millis, MIN(started_at) AS first_round_started_at,MAX(submitted_at) AS last_round_submitted_at FROM repair_round GROUP BY work_order_id ) SELECT w.id,w.work_order_no,r.equipment_name AS reported_equipment_name,w.status, r.first_submitted_at,w.created_at,w.accepted_at,w.completed_at,w.current_round, e.id AS equipment_id,e.equipment_no,e.name AS equipment_name,e.location_id AS equipment_location_id, COALESCE(t.round_count,0) AS round_count,COALESCE(t.submitted_count,0) AS submitted_count, COALESCE(t.bad_round_count,0) AS bad_round_count,COALESCE(t.repair_millis,0) AS repair_millis, t.first_round_started_at,t.last_round_submitted_at FROM work_order w JOIN repair_request r ON r.id=w.request_id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.id=w.equipment_id LEFT JOIN round_totals t ON t.work_order_id=w.id
w.status='COMPLETED' AND w.completed_at>=#{start} AND w.completed_at<#{end} w.created_at>=#{start} AND w.created_at<#{end} 1=1
AND w.completed_at>=#{dateStart} AND w.completed_at<#{dateEnd} AND w.equipment_id=#{equipmentId} AND w.equipment_id IS NULL AND w.status=#{status}
AND (CONVERT(w.work_order_no USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.equipment_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR e.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR CONVERT(e.equipment_no USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY COALESCE(w.completed_at,w.created_at) DESC,w.id DESC
